title: Latency provenance matrix and causal tagging for mixed failure modes
creator: Anika Shah
description: We need a cross-layer ‘latency provenance’ capability and a compact taxonomy that maps mixed failure signals (timeouts, overload, model rejections, model stalls, and HTTP/gRPC codes) to deterministic remediation playbooks. Current dashboards show raw counts and heatmaps, but they do not answer: who induced the spike (proxy, routing, model), whether backpressure propagated from upstream, and whether the model response was a semantic failure vs a transport-level error. This ticket designs and ships a provenance matrix that anchors traces to causal markers (producer-consumer boundary tags, batching boundaries, KV cache hits/misses, kernel selection events) and exposes a dashboard + queryable index for rapid RCA.
acceptance_criteria: A provenance matrix visualization that slices failures by call_path, request_class, model_version, and hardware_pool
Trace enrichment hook implemented in the tracing agent that adds causal tags: 'producer_id', 'backpressure_score', 'batch_id', 'kv_cache_hit', 'kernel_variant'
A dashboard with drilldowns showing latency spike timelines with probable root actor (ingress, router, runtime, model) and confidence score
Failure taxonomy doc published in Confluence and linked from the dashboard with remediation playbooks per failure class
Synthetic test harness that can reproduce and label at least three classes (overload/backpressure, model-timeout, model-error) and shows expected dashboard signal
Metrics and log pipeline changes validated on staging with no >5% cardinality inflation and retention policy reviewed
notes: Decision: use deterministic causal markers rather than heuristic heuristics for first iteration — simplifies proofs and trace joins.
Trade-off: adding 'backpressure_score' increases trace size; mitigated by encoding as small int and sampling on low-traffic tenants.

Implementation plan: tracing hook (open-telemetry) -> ingest transformer to add causal fields to spans -> indexer adds 'provenance_key' to metrics pipeline -> dashboard queries index and raw spans for drilldown.
We will not attempt automated root-cause classification in v1; instead provide a confidence heuristic and human readable evidence bucket.
Aligns with Observability Platform roadmap item: 'trace-anchoring-and-failure-bucketization' but focuses on causal tagging and operator-facing matrix visualization.
